objective: Measure whether MCTS self-play from the selected supervised epoch-3 model improves value prediction and equal-search-budget play.
candidate_selection: Final checkpoint after 100 games; no test/benchmark-based checkpoint selection or hyperparameter tuning.

value_benchmark.scoring: All pre-move positions from naturally completed games only; cutoffs explicitly excluded; compare both models on identical inputs and side-to-move outcomes.
value_benchmark.limitations: Targets are observed outcomes of the frozen baseline playing itself with exploration, not perfect-play values.

strength_comparison.cutoffs: unresolved; report completed-only score and bounds over all games

human_retention.positions: full test split; policy only Hikaru turns, values both sides

notes: Keep the original supervised checkpoint unchanged.
Training cutoff-zero labels are retained as previously requested.
Replay excludes benchmark and human holdout games.
Value curves are diagnostic after training, not checkpoint-selection gates.
A single 100-game pilot and 20 paired matches are not an Elo estimate or definitive evidence of strength.
